about.title: About FC Auto Export
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner in the African automotive export market.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide African customers with access to high-quality, affordable used vehicles through a transparent and reliable export service. We believe everyone deserves a dependable vehicle at a fair price.

story.title: Our Story
story.description: Founded with a vision to bridge the gap between China's automotive market and Africa's growing demand for quality used cars, FC Auto Export has grown into a trusted name across the continent. We serve customers in Cameroon, Nigeria, Senegal, Ghana, Kenya, and many more countries.

items.title: Integrity
items.description: Honest pricing and accurate vehicle descriptions, always.

items.title: Quality
items.description: Only vehicles that pass our rigorous inspection standards.

items.title: Reliability
items.description: On-time shipping and consistent communication throughout.

items.title: Customer First
items.description: Your satisfaction drives every decision we make.
